text:
Anna: Heads up — during the 14:02 traffic spike we saw per-GPU queue depth go >120 while p99 latency for small sync ops jumped from 40ms -> 700ms. Long-lived live-stream calls were holding KV slots for minutes. :warning:
Ravi: Saw the same. Streaming-ish "longcall" sessions were ~25% of requests but accounted for ~80% of active kv entries. Short requests got starved.
Jen: Oof. Any idea why autoscaler didn't spin up more capacity?
Autoscaler-Bot: Autoscaler note: scaling suppressed due to recent manual cap on region-us-west-2 (reserved_capacity=1200 -> cap=1200). No new nodes launched.
Marcus: So two separate problems: admission/routing + scaling caps. We should avoid making short RPCs wait behind long sessions.
Anna: Agreed. I want a quick mitigation that doesn't require infra deploys — per-GPU token-bucket + a short-request fast-path seemed feasible. Could push config to config-service.
Ravi: Proposal prototype (config snippet):
```
admission_policy:
  default_weight: 1
  classes:
    - name: short
      match: header.x-session == "ephemeral" OR token_length < 64
      weight: 5
      max_inflight_per_gpu: 150
      preempt: false
    - name: longcall
      match: header.x-session == "long" OR connection_type == "stream"
      weight: 1
      max_inflight_per_gpu: 40
      preempt: true
  backpressure_strategy: weighted_fair_queueing
  queue_limit: 500
```
Ravi: Points: 1) weight gives priority without starving, 2) preempt true for longcall allows eviction of oldest long requests if we hit hard capacity, 3) separate max_inflight caps avoid kv exhaustion.
Jen: Preempting live sessions will impact user experience — needs product buy-in. But for emergency mode it's fine. Also note cost: if we start preempting longcalls and route short calls to dedicated pool, we might increase token count and drive up spend.
Anna: For immediate action: roll the config to a single AZ in us-west-2 as an experiment. Add a temporary rule to route short class to a small reserved pool (burst pool) we keep empty until needed. That should buy p99 latency relief.
SRE-Bot: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/infra/queueing?from=now-1h&to=now — highlighting GPUs with >80% KV usage.
Marcus: Also we should add a short synthetic test hitting 99th-percentile small requests while longcalls are active to validate fairness. I can add a harness in kitchen.
Jen: Long term we should consider: 1) admission tied to real-time KV usage metric, not just inflight count; 2) finer-grained financial signals (route to cheaper region only when latency allowance); 3) optional graceful degrade for long calls (trim context).
Anna: Agree. Action list: @Ravi roll config to us-west-2 canary, @Marcus add synthetic test, @Jen draft short/long SLA impacts for PMs. I'll monitor the dashboard and post results in 15m. :eyes:
Ravi: Will push canary now to config-service: `cfg push --env prod --zone us-west-2 --policy longcall-fairness-canary`
Autoscaler-Bot: Scaling event queued: attempt-add 2 nodes to us-west-2 in 120s (blocked until capacity check).
Anna: Thanks — if scaling stays blocked we'll enable preemptive eviction after 30s of queue overload.
Marcus: Noted. I'll also add a metric alert for "kv_slot_utilization > 0.85 for 2m" so we can act earlier.
Jen: I'll loop in product on the UX tradeoffs. Good call everyone. :thumbsup:
